newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian bonds lose further ground in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Austrian bonds lose further ground in late trade.

text.p: 1435 GMT - Austrian bonds extend losses in late trade on Thursday in tandem with further losses in the German Bund future and soft Treasuries.
Traders see market remaining edgy due to Germany's problems with reaching the deficit criteria for the single currency.
* 10-year benchmark 5.75 pct bond maturing July 2006 down 95 bps at 99.00 to yield 5.88 (5.75) pct in bourse trade, quoted post-market at 98.76/86 to yield 5.92/90.
* Five-year 4.375 bond maturing February 2002 closed down 40 bps at 98.10 in bourse trade to yield 4.83 (4.73) pct, quoted post-market at 98.00/10 to yield 4.85/83 percent.
* Austrian bond future down 56 bps at 108.14 on turnover of 1,058 lots.
* 10-year spread over Germany up two bps at zero, five-year spread down four at 13 bps.
* Money market rates lower with three-month VIBOR at 3.418 and overnight money at 3.07/3.32. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 53112 256
